{{Quote|Always knew he wouldn't make it.|Aalto, commenting on Obi-Wan Kenobi being sent to the Agricultural Corps|<ref name="JA2: TRF" />}}
'''Aalto''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and a friend of<ref name="DB" /> the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]]<ref name="JA2: TRF" /> [[Bruck Chun]]. Aalto spent [[Time/Legends|time]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]],<ref name="DB" /> located on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and frequently joined in on the teasing of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="DB" /> another Jedi initiate.<ref name="JA2: TRF" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Kenobi was not accepted for training as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and was sent to the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]].<ref name="JA2: TRF" /> While at a table with Chun during a [[Local day/Legends|morning]] meal at the temple, Aalto teased Kenobi about his failure, loudly stating that they always knew he would not make it.<ref name="JA2: TRF" /> Aalto used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aalto first appeared in the [[1999]] young-readers novel ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]'', which was written by [[Dave Wolverton]] as the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' series.<ref name="JA2: TRF" />
